# `aitbc governance propose`

Create a new governance proposal with title, description, and optional category.

## Usage

```bash
aitbc governance propose [OPTIONS]
```

## Options

| Option | Type | Default | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `--title` | text | — | yes | Proposal title |
| `--description` | text | — | yes | Proposal description |
| `--type` | text | `parameter_change` | no | Proposal type (parameter_change, fund_allocation, etc.) |
| `--category` | text | `general` | no | Proposal category |
| `--proposer-id` | text | — | yes | Proposer profile ID |
| `--proposer-address` | text | — | no | Proposer wallet address (for on-chain submission) |
| `--params` | text | — | no | JSON-encoded parameters for parameter_change proposals |
| `--execution-payload` | text | — | no | JSON the EXECUTE binds to (v13). Defaults to --params; required for any non-parameter_change proposal |
| `--voting-days` | integer | `7` | no | Voting period in days |
| `--wallet` | text | — | no | Wallet to sign the on-chain GOVERNANCE_PROPOSE tx (client-signed submission) |
| `--password-stdin` | flag | `false` | no | Read the wallet password from one line of standard input |
| `--password-file` | file | — | no | Path to a file containing only the wallet password (mode 0600, owned by you) |
| `--password` | text | — | no | Wallet password (deprecated: visible in process lists and shell history; prefer --password-stdin or --password-file) |
| `--format` | choice | — | no | Output format |

## Examples

```bash
aitbc governance propose --title <title> --description <description> --proposer-id <proposer_id>
```
